review.boundary_review: The gutter at x≈355 separates the target page from fol. 45b. The fol. 45b fragments ('see also Pañcakrośī', '…3:8/10:D', '…samidakṣaṇa') are context only and are not transcribed as target records. Three arrows cross the gutter to b. 69, c. 68 (4) and d. 330(1); these links are recorded as probable or uncertain. Ditto dashes from c. 68 (4) to d. 330(1) are taken as repeating Kāśīmāhātmya (b. 69) with probable certainty. Nothing on fol. 46b continues this page.

region_review.top: Pencil page number and the interlinear note above d. 312 (9) are present. No other writing.
region_review.middle: All entries, headings, cancellations and pencil 'Same work' and '2ff. inc.' notes are reconciled. The tear at the gutter and the arrows are unattached marks.
region_review.bottom: The d. 814 entry, its two continuation lines and 'partly Jaina' are present. Below them is blank ruled paper, apart from a small stray stroke near d. 814.
region_review.left_margin: Shelfmark column notes b016 and b023 are present. Gutter arrows come from fol. 45b, and the facing-page fragments are excluded.
region_review.right_margin: Extent columns, interlinear fractions and 'Beng.' are present. A grey smudge near d. 309 is a non-text mark.
region_review.interlinear: Insertions 11/4, ut, hm, 3rd vibhāga, 8, 10/14, 7, 7/8, 11/13, 9/12 and the pencil 6/8 are all represented.

The struck '1799' is followed by '1856' in the description. The right column independently reads '1799'. The first digit of the extent has another stroke written over or above it, which cannot be read. The two dates are not reconciled in the source.
